in_marathi.name: Bidya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bidya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bidya is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'vid', meaning 'to know'. In Hindu mythology, Bidya is associated with Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge and wisdom. This name is often given to girls to signify a deep desire for knowledge and learning.
